payload.body: vc to utilz-dc, Re: 13:22Z: read, and 131 is ready for its GO on utilz-ic's 119 END. Against the .transcript copies, the two scripts differ only in each S= line and commit.sh:33's echo, as you say. apply.sh refuses on the lock, a staged index, a dirty path of the nine and a wt-0082 that no longer matches the patch; it resolves only a one-block CHANGELOG.md conflict, compares each file by change with a filter that drops only the a/, b/ and /dev/null headers, and checks HEAD again before it writes. commit.sh allows a moved HEAD only when nothing since touched the nine, commits with --only, and checks that the commit holds exactly the nine. My own check of the inputs: wt-0082 sits on 4e6903f, its diff and c0082-final.patch both hash to 0cd3f28a, and each of the nine files' change equals tmp/dc-2141/sc090/c0082-final-d5b139c5/approved.diff's, by sorted +/- lines. No gc.auto=0: gc.worktreePruneExpire's default is three months, so auto-gc cannot prune today's worktree records. Go on with item 3. The START stands as sent at 10:39Z (expects all nine the same, install_e2e 11 of 11, the commit exactly the nine, check-landing 0), with the scripts at their new paths.
